## Recommended Approach: Offline-First Mobile System with Local Server

### Core Architecture

**KoboToolbox + KoboCollect** for data collection, paired with **Baserow** (self-hosted) or **NocoDB** as the central database, running on a local server with occasional cloud sync when connectivity permits.

---

## Specific Tools & Costs (PHP 400,000 ≈ USD 6,800)

| Component | Tool | Cost (PHP) |
|-----------|------|-----------|
| **Mobile data collection** | KoboToolbox (free, open-source) | 0 |
| **Server hardware** | Refurbished Dell OptiPlex or local build (16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) | 45,000 |
| **Offline server platform** | NocoDB (free, open-source) or Baserow self-hosted | 0 |
| **10 Android tablets** | Samsung Galaxy Tab A9 or Xiaomi Redmi Pad SE (PHP 8,500 × 10) | 85,000 |
| **Solar charging stations** | 2× Goal Zero Yeti 200X + solar panels (field charging) | 95,000 |
| **Portable router/MiFi** | 3× Globe/TM prepaid units with load | 15,000 |
| **Training (biggest line item)** | 5-day intensive + 6 monthly follow-ups; external facilitator | 120,000 |
| **Contingency & maintenance** | Spare cables, cases, repairs | 40,000 |
| **TOTAL** | | **400,000** |

---

## How It Works

### Daily Operations (Fully Offline)
- Field staff use **KoboCollect** on tablets; forms download via WiFi at office, work offline for days
- Data stores locally; photos, GPS, signatures all function without connectivity
- Return to office: auto-sync to **NocoDB** on local server over office WiFi

### When Connectivity Exists
- NocoDB syncs encrypted backups to free tier of **Backblaze B2** or **Wasabi** (~PHP 0 if <10GB; minimal cost if exceeded)
- Managers access dashboards via any browser; no software installation

### Data Structure
- Client registration, visit logs, referrals, stock/inventory, simple case management
- NocoDB provides spreadsheet-like interface that non-technical staff can modify

---

## Post-Donor Sustainability (Month 18+)

| Cost Category | Annual Cost (PHP) | Funding Strategy |
|-------------|------------------|------------------|
| Server electricity | ~6,000 | Absorbed into operations |
| Cloud backup (if needed) | ~3,000 | Optional; can use physical backup only |
| 1-2 tablet replacements/year | ~17,000 | Depreciation reserve from Year 1 (40k contingency → 22k remaining) |
| **Total annual tech cost** | **~20,000** | **0.5% of typical nonprofit admin budget** |

### Sustainability Mechanisms Built In

1. **Zero subscription dependency** — no Salesforce, no Microsoft, no ongoing vendor lock-in
2. **Staff ownership** — training includes 2 "super-user" staff who become internal trainers
3. **Hardware durability** — solar charging extends tablet lifespan; rugged cases included
4. **Exit transition** — Month 15-18: document all systems, train board member on basic troubleshooting

### If Funding Completely Zero

System continues running on local server indefinitely. Data exportable to Excel/CSV anytime. No vendor can disable access. Organization owns everything.

---

## Why Not Common Alternatives

| Alternative | Why Rejected |
|-------------|-------------|
| **CommCare/Dimagi** | USD 100-300/month subscription; unsustainable post-donor |
| **ODK Central cloud-hosted** | Requires reliable internet; recurring hosting costs |
| **Excel/Google Sheets** | No offline photo/GPS capture; sync conflicts common |
| **Custom app development** | PHP 400k insufficient; maintenance burden |

---

## Implementation Timeline

- **Months 1-2**: Hardware procurement, server setup, form design with staff
- **Months 3-4**: Pilot with 5 staff, iterate
- **Months 5-6**: Full rollout, intensive training
- **Months 7-18**: Monthly check-ins, documentation for handover
